component.name: fstl

developer.name: Matt Keeter and the fstl-app contributors

component.summary: Fast viewer and exporter for STL 3D model files

description.p: fstl is a very fast viewer for .stl 3D model files, designed to load and render very high-polygon models instantly — 2 million triangles at 60+ FPS on a mid-range laptop.

ul.li: Arcball rotation, panning, and zoom about the cursor
Four draw modes: shaded, wireframe, surface angle, and a configurable two-light shader
Standard viewpoints, perspective or orthographic projection, and optional axes display
Automatic reload when the model changes on disk — ideal alongside CAD tools
Browse between .stl files in a folder with the arrow keys
Rotation PNG series: evenly spaced views around a chosen axis
Animated turntable GIFs, looping up to 360° or bouncing between two angles

A full command-line mode (fstl --help) that renders without opening a window, with configurable model color, transparent or colored backgrounds, resolution limits, batch directory processing, and stdin pipelines

description.p: PNG and animated GIF exporters (GUI and command line), Qt 6 support, crash fixes, faster loading, desktop integration, and a man page.
